Vanna Protocol introduces isolated SmartAccount sandboxes on Stellar Soroban Protocol 20 to eliminate pool contagion and front-running liquidations.

Features include ~320ms Mercury telemetry, fixed 0.00014

Why the next generation of on-chain credit cannot rely on monolithic liquidity pools.

During volatility spikes, decentralized money markets face two major failure modes: mempool congestion and shared pool contagion. Vanna resolves these structural bottlenecks at the smart contract level on Stellar Soroban.

By deploying dedicated SmartAccount sandboxes, risk is localized. Deficits remain quarantined without compromising depositors.

Explore the institutional architecture on testnet: Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

**Title:** Technical breakdown: Composable 10x Margin Routing on Blend v2 Pools (Post On Blend)

Here is how we designed Vanna's credit architecture on Soroban Protocol 20:

- State isolation inside dedicated SmartAccount contracts
- Sub-second Mercury indexer streaming (~320ms)
- Deterministic fees fixed at 0.00014 XLM

Documentation and testnet deployments: Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

*(Disclosure: Core builder at Vanna Protocol. Testing on Stellar Testnet only.)*
